title: The Theorems of Dr. David Blackwell and Their Contributions to Artificial Intelligence
abstract: arXiv:2604.06621v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Dr. David Blackwell was a mathematician and statistician of the first rank, whose contributions to statistical theory, game theory, and decision theory predated many of the algorithmic breakthroughs that define modern artificial intelligence. This survey examines three of his most consequential theoretical results the Rao Blackwell theorem, the Blackwell Approachability theorem, and the Blackwell Informativeness theorem (comparison of experiments) and traces their direct influence on contemporary AI and machine learning. We show that these results, developed primarily in the 1940s and 1950s, remain technically live across modern subfields including Markov Chain Monte Carlo inference, autonomous mobile robot navigation (SLAM), generative model training, no-regret online learning, reinforcement learning from human feedback (RLHF), large language model alignment, and information design. translated_title: 大卫·布莱克韦尔博士的定理及其对人工智能的贡献
translated_abstract: arXiv:2604.06621v2 公告类型：替换-交叉 摘要：大卫·布莱克韦尔博士是一位一流的数学家和统计学家，他在统计理论、博弈论和决策理论方面的贡献，早于许多定义现代人工智能的算法突破。本综述考察了他的三项最具影响力的理论成果——拉奥-布莱克韦尔定理、布莱克韦尔可逼近性定理和布莱克韦尔信息性定理（实验比较），并追溯了它们对当代人工智能和机器学习的直接影响。我们表明，这些主要发展于20世纪40年代和50年代的成果，在现代子领域中仍然具有技术生命力，包括马尔可夫链蒙特卡洛推断、自主移动机器人导航（SLAM）、生成模型训练、无遗憾在线学习、从人类反馈中强化学习（RLHF）、大型语言模型对齐和信息设计。英伟达2024年决定将其旗舰产品命名，也印证了这一点。
tldr: 本文综述了布莱克韦尔的三项核心定理（拉奥-布莱克韦尔、可逼近性和信息性）如何深刻影响现代人工智能各子领域，从推断、导航到模型对齐，并指出其理论至今仍具技术活力。
en_tdlr: This survey shows how Blackwell's three core theorems (Rao-Blackwell, approachability, and informativeness) deeply influence modern AI subfields, from inference and navigation to model alignment, demonstrating their enduring technical relevance.
